notes: RC122: Smart 3D depth runs smoother. The per-map depth post-processing was throwing away memory every frame (rebuilding fixed tables and re-allocating buffers), which made the headset pause to clean up — that showed as the video freezing for up to ~2 seconds and depth arriving late and re-settling. Same depth quality, same 8 MB model, just far less waste. Quest validation required: compare the Smart report's stall and depth-lag numbers against rc121.
